contributor to MP (1874)

The Literary Year Book (1901), 239, lists \'WOOD, MISS FRANCES HARIOTT, Elmwood, 116 Bromley Road, Beckenham, Kent.\' She published both fiction and plays between the 1870s and 1920s.
